A standalone Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator for Android, powered by SameBoy %1$s by Lior Halphon.

Ported to Android by OOZI.

Achievements are provided by RetroAchievements.org, through its open-source rcheevos library.

SameBoy is released under the Expat (MIT) license. The included boot ROMs are SameBoy's own open-source replacements; no Nintendo code is included.

Tap a game to play it, long-press it for save file options. In a game, use the ☰ button or Back to open the menu.
